WITH budget_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    b.link_to_event,
    e.location,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.amount = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS FLOAT)
    END AS ratio
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    location,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY link_to_event, location
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM event_avg_ratios
)
SELECT 
  link_to_event AS event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank
